educationalGoal: In this course, students learn how to program and control a small drone (Ryze Tech. Tello) using Python.
advice: Create a multi-process program that communicates with Tello via UDP according to the specifications published by Ryze Tech to control the aircraft and acquire aircraft information. The program is designed to communicate with Tello via UDP in accordance with the specifications published by Ryze Tech. 【Development environment】 Operating system: Linux Language: Python3 (mainly used modules: socket, multiprocessing, opencv, pygame, matplotlib) 【Notes】 The course assumes that students have a good understanding of the basics of Python, so no explanations will be given in class. The course covers a wide range of topics in a short period of time, so students are expected to prepare for and review the class slides and programs thoroughly before attending each class.
requiredKnowledge: Python basics: (1) Variables and lists, (2) Conditional branching, (3) Iteration, (4) Function definition and calling, (5) Using modules) Experience with programming text editors such as VisualStudio Code Experience with Linux

lessons.content: Before Programming - How to use PC - How to connect Tello to PC - Flight Practice - How drones work
Network Programming (UDP) After understanding the protocols provided by the Tello, learn how to communicate with the drone via UDP socket using the Python's socket module.
Video Processing Programming Using Python's opencv module, display the H.264 video stream sent from the drone on a PC screen.
Gamepad Programming Using Python's pygame module, you will learn how to read information (buttons and axes) from a USB gamepad and use it.
Waveform Plot Programming The matplotlib module of Python is used to display the information (attitude, altitude, battery level, etc.) sent from the drone.

Multi-processing programming Using Python's multiprocessing module, multiple tasks (i.e., (1) joypad input, (2) drone control, (3) visualization of drone information, and (4) display of video streams.)
Free time Time for flight experiments (each student will m odify the program and make the drone fly.)
